about: Who made each catalogue in assets/locale, and how much to trust it. Checked by tests/integration/catalogues.tooling.test.js. See docs/language-support-plan.md. A catalogue may list in "sameAsEnglish" the messages whose English word is also the usual word in that language.

origins.human: written by a person (see the git history of the catalogue for who)
origins.machine: generated by a language model, not reviewed by a speaker of the language
origins.merged: the work of a person, with the messages it lacked (or only had as outdated fuzzy entries) filled in by a language model, and a few plainly wrong entries replaced; see translations/comparison.md

tiers.1: well-resourced language: machine translation is generally reliable
tiers.2: mid-resourced language: usable, worth a native speaker's review
tiers.3: low-resource language: the first to drop if review finds the translation misleading
